name: zoo-sync
description: Sync VS Code settings, keybindings and extensions across Windows, macOS and Linux through a private GitHub repository.

zooSync.repository.markdownDescription: Private GitHub repository used as sync storage, in `owner/name` form. Use **Zoo Sync: Configure Repository** to set or create it.

zooSync.profiles.markdownDescription: Profiles whose settings, keybindings, extensions and files are synced. Use **Zoo Sync: Choose Profiles to Sync** to pick them. A profile in the repository that does not exist here is reported, never created.

zooSync.files.markdownDescription: Extra files to sync. A relative path is synced inside every profile (`snippets/**`, `tasks.json`); a path starting with `~/` is synced once per machine (`~/.gitconfig`). Use `{ "path": "~/.config/x.toml", "perPlatform": true }` to keep one copy per platform, and `{ "path": { "windows": "…", "*": "…" } }` when the path differs per platform. `*` matches within a folder, `**` crosses folders. Files over 1 MB, binaries, and names that look like credentials are skipped.

zooSync.branch.description: Branch that stores the synced data.

zooSync.autoSync.description: Sync on startup, poll the remote periodically and upload local changes automatically.

zooSync.remotePollMinutes.description: How often (minutes) to check the remote repository for changes.

zooSync.localSyncMinutes.description: How often (minutes) to upload detected local changes.

zooSync.ignoredSettings.markdownDescription: Setting keys that are never synced. `*` matches any characters (including `.`); matching is case-sensitive. Keys that look like secrets (`apiKey`, `accessToken`, `password`, `secret`) are always skipped.

zooSync.ignoredExtensions.description: Extension ids (publisher.name) that are never synced.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: tsc --noEmit && eslint src test && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.compile: tsc --noEmit && eslint src test && node esbuild.js
